mcp.note: Live MCP server on Cloudflare Workers (agent-friendly-platform, Hono + D1). POST this endpoint with JSON-RPC initialize, then tools/list, then tools/call. Catalog and orders are served from D1.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List all products with price and stock.

tools.name: recommend_products
tools.description: Recommend 1 first choice + 1 alternative based on use and budget. Read guide.md / recommendations.json first.

tools.name: calculate_total
tools.description: Calculate subtotal, shipping (12 CNY, free over 200 CNY) and total for a list of items.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create an order. Requires idempotency_key. Returns the order with payment instructions (offline payment). Status starts as pending_payment. shipping_address is REQUIRED — create_order rejects orders without it. Ask the buyer for name, contact and shipping address at the confirmation step (buyer_name / buyer_contact optional, shipping_address required) BEFORE create_order: ask first, create only after you have the address, never create first and ask afterwards. After create_order, send the buyer the payment instructions returned with the order (method + the seller's configured receiving account, verbatim) and the proof-upload link returned with the order (proof_upload.url), and tell the buyer the 15-minute deadline: the order auto-cancels if no payment proof is submitted within 15 minutes of creation. Proof has two paths: a transaction id goes through submit_payment_proof; a payment screenshot goes through the upload link — the buyer uploads it directly in a browser, never ask the agent to read the transaction id out of a screenshot. Do NOT start tracking yet: tracking starts only after a proof is submitted and the order becomes payment_submitted. 姓名、联系方式没给的可事后用 update_buyer_info 补填；收货地址是必填的，下单时必须有。

tools.name: submit_payment_proof
tools.description: Submit offline payment proof for an order: transaction id and payment method. Use only when the buyer sends a transaction id as text. If the buyer sends a payment screenshot, do NOT read the transaction id out of it — use get_payment_proof_upload_link and send the buyer the link to upload the screenshot directly. The order becomes payment_submitted (awaiting seller verification), NOT paid. The seller must then verify the actual receipt and amount with confirm_payment. After a successful call, start tracking the order (check get_order every 6 hours, notify on change, until completed or cancelled; delete the tracking task if the order is cancelled). Never ask the buyer for their own card numbers or verification codes.

tools.name: get_payment_proof_upload_link
tools.description: Get a one-time upload link for the buyer to submit a payment screenshot directly to the platform. Use this whenever the buyer has a payment screenshot instead of a transaction id: do NOT read the transaction id out of the screenshot — send the buyer this link to upload the image in a browser. The image goes straight to the platform and the order becomes payment_submitted; the seller verifies the screenshot visually in the admin UI. Single-use, expires in 7 days; call again for a fresh link if used or expired. Note: the order itself auto-cancels 15 minutes after creation if no proof is submitted, so the link is only useful within that 15-minute payment window. After the buyer uploads (order payment_submitted), start tracking the order (6-hour get_order checks).

tools.name: confirm_payment
tools.description: SELLER-ONLY: confirm that an offline payment was actually received, after checking the real receipt (bank / WeChat / Alipay). Requires the order to be payment_submitted with at least one proof, and verified_amount_cny must equal the order total; on mismatch the order stays payment_submitted. On success the order becomes paid. No seller authentication on this tool yet in this demo.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get an order by id, including payment and shipping status, payment proofs, and the full status timeline. Use this for the automatic 6-hour order tracking checks.

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: SELLER-ONLY: mark a paid order as shipped, with optional carrier and tracking_number. Requires the order to be paid. The seller admin web UI calls the same logic behind API-key auth.

tools.name: confirm_receipt
tools.description: Buyer confirms receipt of a shipped order; the order becomes completed. If the buyer does not confirm, the order auto-completes 7 days after shipping.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order before it is paid. Only pending_payment and payment_submitted orders can be cancelled; a paid order cannot be cancelled this way. After a successful cancel, also cancel/delete the tracking task for this order if one was created.

tools.name: update_buyer_info
tools.description: Fill in or correct buyer info (name, contact, shipping address) for an order created without it. At least one field is required; only given fields change. Allowed until the order ships.

mcp_apps.note: Platform-owned widget template, fed by tool structuredContent (the IR). The shop never ships HTML/CSS. Tools MUST return meaningful text content even when UI is available. Renders on Claude web/desktop and ChatGPT; Claude Code shows text only; Grok does not render MCP Apps.

elicitation.use_for: One blocking choice or confirm (flat JSON Schema, enums), Claude Code only. URL mode for payment/sign-in only.
elicitation.note: claude.ai web elicitation support is unverified; do not depend on it there.

grok.rendering: Markdown/text only. No rich-UI convention for third parties.

presentation.fallback: Markdown text from api/presentation.json markdown_fallback. Numbered options, plain links, one question per turn, total verbatim.

payment.note: 确认订单后，卖家提供线下收款方式；买家在 Agent 外付款，付款后把交易单号发给 Agent，订单变为待核验；卖家核对到账和金额后用 confirm_payment 确认（金额必须等于订单总额），确认后才标记已付款并发货；发货后买家用 confirm_receipt 确认收货，订单完成，7 天无人确认自动完成；付款前可用 cancel_order 取消。不要在聊天里索要或接收银行卡号、验证码。
